lines.beaver_en: How was the exhibition? There were so many sculptures.
lines.learner: 응, 전시장이 넓어서 좋았어. 조각도 예술적이었고.
lines.en: Yeah, the hall was spacious. The sculptures were artistic too.
lines.roman: eung, jeonsijangi neolbeoseo joasseo. jogakdo yesuljeogieotgo.

lines.beaver: 작품 수는 어땠어? 좀 많지 않았어?
lines.beaver_en: How about the number of works? Weren't there a bit too many?
lines.beaver_roman: jakpum suneun eottaesseo? jom manchi anasseo?
lines.en: Rather than too many, I think it was just right.

lines.beaver: 근데 너 어제 발표회도 갔다며? 어땠어?
lines.beaver_en: By the way, I heard you went to a recital yesterday. How was it?
lines.beaver_roman: geunde neo eoje balpyohoedo gatdamyeo? eottaesseo?
lines.en: Yeah, it was a theater showcase, and it was really fun.

lines.learner: 응, 탤런트 한 명이 무대에 등장했어.
lines.en: Yeah, a TV actor appeared on stage.
lines.roman: eung, taelleonteu han myeongi mudaee deungjanghaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, really? How did people react?
lines.learner: 등장하자마자 다들 박수를 치고 소리를 질렀어.
lines.en: As soon as he came out, everyone clapped and shouted.
lines.roman: deungjanghajamaja dadeul baksureul chigo sorireul jilleosseo.

lines.beaver_en: How was his acting? Was he good?
lines.en: Yeah, his acting was way more impressive than his looks.

lines.beaver_en: Was admission expensive? Hard to get tickets, right?
lines.learner: 입장은 무료였는데 자리가 없어서 간신히 앉았어.
lines.en: Entry was free, but seats were scarce, so I barely got one.
lines.roman: ipjangeun muryoyeonneunde jariga eopseoseo gansinhi anjasseo.

lines.beaver_en: What genre was the show? Comedy?
lines.en: Rather than funny, it was a sad family story.

lines.beaver: 연출은 누가 했어? 영화 쪽 사람이야?
lines.beaver_en: Who directed it? Someone from film?
lines.beaver_roman: yeonchureun nuga haesseo? yeonghwa jjok saramiya?
lines.en: Yeah, a famous film director. A real artist.

lines.beaver: 다음엔 나도 데려가. 이제 밥 먹으러 갈까?
lines.beaver_en: Take me next time. Shall we go eat now?
lines.beaver_roman: daeumen nado deryeoga. ije bap meogeureo galkka?
lines.learner: 좋아! 다음 공연은 꼭 같이 보자.
lines.en: Sure! Let's definitely see the next show together.
lines.roman: joa! daeum gongyeoneun kkok gachi boja.
